title: [GAP-3] Incident response is missing for most key classes
description: Review finding GAP-3: Incident response is missing for most key classes (lens GAP). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:12; spec/02-identity.md:117-247, 437; spec/06-calls.md:345; spec/10-relays.md:231. Fix: Narrow the list. (1) Losing the owner key does not freeze the Space for did:webvh or did:plc owners. Space state is signed by the owner DID's authentication key (03:131), and DID recovery restores it: the recovery key, social recovery, and for employees the org helpdesk path (02:471), which works even after offboarding because the org holds the update key. Losing the key is fatal only for a `did:key` owner. What remains is compromise: a hostile ownership transfer signed by a stolen owner key has no undo, and nothing says how clients treat state signed by a device key that was later revoked. (2) Recovery-key theft is partly handled by §2.4.4 (02:238-245: log ordering, conflict detection, a 24 h admin-review rule). What is missing is rotating a compromised recovery or social key out. (3) Drop the sequencer: a forged stamp is equivocation, which 14-jmap:188 already detects and handles. (4) Drop the push proxy and Space endpoint/TLS bullets. They state no attacker gain, and §3.4 (03:161) already says an endpoint "can withhold state but cannot forge it". Keep the following: logger/recorder key rotation and re-encryption, a manifest `status: "revoked"`, bulk response to a provisioning-ke Full text: notes/review/GAP-verified.md and notes/review/GAP.md.
